_what: The list every imported AI conversation gets one row in (src/chat-import.mjs keepConversationRow): made once with ensure, then each import writes only the facts read from the chat (title, app, conversation, first and last message, count, models). Labels, people, pursuits and follow-ups are left for the person and their AIs, so a re-import never overwrites them. A new field is a row here.
label: AI conversations
about: Every conversation you had with an AI, one row each, with when it happened, what it was about and which pursuits and people it touches.
